messages:
Maya: quick sync 0 compact autoscale rows feel cramped in the new workload table. Folks keep missing burst controls and the SLO knob.

Jonah: agreed. dense table is great for power users but discoverability is dropping. we saw a 40% drop in burst toggles in the last test.

Priya: could we use a small inline affordance instead of expanding cards? e.g., a chevron that opens an anchor panel.

Luis: +1 but prefer a single visible hint: a tiny pill that reads 'Burst • Latency' so people know the concepts exist.

Quinn: accessibility note: if the hint is hover-only it disappears for keyboard users. it must be focusable and have a clear keyboard flow.

Maya: proposal: left-aligned compact row with a trailing pill 'Burst • Latency' that is tabbable. on Enter it expands an inline panel with controls: min, max, burst-quanta, latency SLO slider, and a link to "Suggest pools".

Jonah: love the flow. can we include micro copy under the slider: 'Lower = cost-first, Higher = latency-first' so PMs understand the tradeoff quickly?

Priya: yes. also change label to 'Latency SLO (p95)' and tooltip: 'Target p95 model response latency.' testers confused by 'SLO' alone.

Luis: UX edge: what if user sets min > selected pool capacity? we should NOT auto-switch their pool. show inline warning and a 'Suggest compatible pools' CTA that opens a pre-filtered selector.

Quinn: in the selector modal add quick filters: GPU type, preemptible, region and a sort called 'Estimated headroom'. makes it faster to pick.

infra-bot: note: headroom calculation queries cluster metrics; suggest caching results per modal session to avoid spikes.

Maya: dev handoff checklist: 1) pill is focusable + expands on Enter/Space; 2) inline panel has numeric inputs + +/- steppers for accessibility; 3) slider has aria attributes and a numeric field; 4) copy updated to 'Burst capacity' and 'Latency SLO (p95)'; 5) inline warning + suggest modal; 6) analytics events: panel_open, burst_toggle, slo_change, suggest_pool_click; 7) mocks attached.

Jonah: QA: slider keyboard: left/right step 1, page up/down step 10, Home/End to min/max. confirm role=\"slider\" and aria-valuenow present.

Priya: I'll own copy and localization strings. ETA EOD.

Luis: designbot can you attach mock with keyboard overlays and the numeric steppers?

designbot: https://redwood.design/figs/1799998888/compact-pill-expand.png (annotations: tabbable pill, aria labels, focus outline, numeric steppers)

Maya: also add inline example states: collapsed, expanded, error when min>pool, and suggestion modal empty state.

Quinn: analytics follow-up: capture how often users open the panel vs toggle burst directly. need to measure discoverability.

Maya: added analytics to the ticket. I'll create INF-1930 with acceptance criteria and attach mocks + aria annotation export.

infra-bot: ticket INF-1930 created and linked to design files.

Jonah: tiny copy tweak: change 'Suggest compatible pools' -> 'Suggest pools with capacity' (clearer).

Priya: noted and updated in the string doc.

Maya: thanks all. once devs pick up, please post any accessibility gaps here. closing thread. :heart:
